description:
Re-enter an AGNTA AgentIdentity binding that has not reached ``registered``.

Branches on SIGNING CAPABILITY, not on a status label: an OWNER /
SessionSigner wallet is moved to ``pending`` and handed a fresh UNSIGNED
``register_identity`` instruction -- the OWNER signs it with their own
wallet (no key material ever reaches Crank, hard rule 1) and then calls
submit_agnta_identity_registration, or submits it themselves and calls
poll_agnta_identity_registration. A TURNKEY-AUTONOMOUS wallet re-runs the
real build + sign + submit instead. An already-``registered`` wallet is a
no-op.
name: request_agnta_identity_registration
